newsitem.title: CHINA: China Nov imports down 3.5 pct from Oct -newspaper.
newsitem.headline: China Nov imports down 3.5 pct from Oct -newspaper.

text.p: China's imports in November were $11.62 billion, down 3.5 percent from October, the China Daily said on Saturday.
Exports in November were $13.62 billion, a rise of 11.8 percent from the month before, the newspaper said. It did not give a year-on-year change for imports or exports.
Total trade in November alone was $25.24 billion, up 4.2 percent from last year, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
China registered a trade surplus of about $2 billion in November, according to the latest official figures.
The country's trade surplus was $14 billion in the first 11 months of 1996, the figures show.
China's trade surplus was $12.01 billion in the first 10 months and $3.91 billion in October alone.
